desc: Implement forced `T` placement with overlap conflict detection.
Build and maintain `F`-window clause status and remaining unassigned-position counts.
Implement lexicographically smallest left-to-right greedy assignment using the remaining-count feasibility condition.
Test examples and adversarial edge cases, then provide the complete `Solution.generateString` code.
Derive the core reduction of each unsatisfied `F` window to a disjunction requiring at least one differing unassigned character.
Prove correctness and analyze `O(nm)` time and `O(n)` auxiliary space.
